source.table: Table 5. Outlays of the U.S. Government, October 2026 and Other Periods
source.title: Department of the Treasury (bureaus excluding IRS)

unit_note: USD millions. Table 5 uses dots for no transactions and (**) for amounts below $500,000 in absolute value. Both marks are omitted from the numeric cells. Covers Departmental Offices, Bureau of the Fiscal Service, Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau, Bureau of Engraving and Printing, and United States Mint on p17. Housing and Economic Recovery Programs and Transportation Services print only omission marks and are preserved as labels. October omits September's ESF - Economic Stabilization Program and Interest Paid to Credit Financing Accounts rows. The 46 standalone cells enter Total--Department of the Treasury in the companion departmental unit.
